services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: About Spend an unforgettable morning with us on Beautiful Lake Tahoe fishing for Mackinaw Trout, Brown Trout, Rainbow Trout, and Kokanee Salmon, all the while taking in the beauty that Lake Tahoe has to offer! There are typically 5-7 people fishing on a public charter. Please see our private charter information if your group will be 6 or more people fishing. Duration Winter (November - March) 4 hour morning, 4 hours afternoon Summer (April - October) 5 hours morning, 4 hours afternoon CA or NV Fishing License NEEDED We sell daily and annual CA Fishing Licenses For public trips, one child aged 5 and under can join for free. services.name: 3 Hour Private Evening Fishing Charter
services.desc: Duration 3 Hours For groups of 6 or more people fishing. Enjoy an unforgettable evening on your own private charter. Relax and enjoy your day fishing for your dinner as you take in all the beauty of the Sierra's! Perfect for your Family Reunion Bachelor party or Corporate group! An unforgettable experience on Beautiful Lake Tahoe fishing for Mackinaw Trout, Brown Trout, Rainbow Trout and/or Kokanee Salmon. Go see Emerald Bay and cruise along the beautiful shoreline enjoying the sightseeing! Your trip includes all your bait, tackle, rods, refreshments waters, sodas, and all the fish are cleaned and bagged! Our boats are Coast Guard Certified. Ride-along (non fishing) rates available as well!
